nodes.label: Sovereign Website (us)
nodes.evidence: A team of AI agents builds a website from the customer's photos and words; five designs to choose from; files, change history and address are the customer's; plain static files, no cookies by default; changes by talking to the owner's own AI within a behaviour policy, each a commit that can be undone; an open pattern first, a hosted offer second.
